energy_limits.energy_definition: coincident canonical kinetic energy plus physical potential; exclude no terms from the fixed Hamiltonian

failure_handling.nonzero_or_nonfinite_branch: Retain source, logs and all committed chunks; latch a control failure and start no subsequent branch/seed. No replacement stream or favorable subset.
failure_handling.resume: Load the exact branch Context checkpoint and redundant raw state; verify source/model/config/initial-state hashes and saved step. No new Maxwell draw.
failure_handling.uncertain_equivalence: If an interval overlaps a margin boundary, label numerical equivalence unresolved. Do not widen the margin or lengthen/select the stage based on its D.

fixed_run.checkpoint_times_ps: 0,1,2,3,4;committed partial checkpoints retained if an invocation ends between those boundaries

physics.native_integrator: OpenMM VerletIntegrator with synchronized canonical momenta
physics.production_thermostat: none; only the one initial COM-projected Maxwell draw

purpose: Numerical time-step control on all original100ps configurations; cannot repair a failed preparation gate or establish liquid diffusion convergence.

source_selection.pending_momentum_draw: Restore saved external NumPy RNG and perform exactly one native.sample_momenta(remove_com=True) draw; save the canonical q and sampled p plus before/after RNG once, and use that same physical initial state for both branches.
source_selection.source_checkpoint_contract: Frozen v2 raw q/v identity, independently bounded CPU force-cache change and canonical-momentum conversion consistency.

statistics.incomplete_cohort: Refuse aggregate transport comparison until all eight pairs are complete.
statistics.overall_numerical_control_rule: All16 branches complete with valid source/phase, finite observations and the fixed energy limits; both primary and secondary paired intervals lie entirely within the fixed margin.
statistics.primary_endpoint: D_VACF = integral of molecular COM velocity-dot VACF from0 to2ps divided by3; equally weighted valid time origins and molecules
statistics.primary_equivalence_rule: The entire two-sided95% paired t confidence interval must lie within[-0.01,+0.01]. Merely including zero or failure to reject a difference is insufficient.
statistics.secondary_endpoint: D_MSD = slope of unwrapped molecular COM mean-squared displacement over1 to2ps divided by6; report raw slope without clipping
statistics.secondary_role: Apply the same declared interval test and report separately; a primary numerical pass does not imply an MSD pass.
statistics.unit_of_uncertainty: one paired seed-chain difference; eight independent random streams, with shared initial preparation history explicitly retained

timing_estimate.qualification: Conditional estimate before execution; no extra original integration worker launched. Controls await completion of the original cohort and resource reassignment.
